eyebrow: WukongMind Browser for iPhone and iPad
h1: Make any web page work your way.
lead: Too cluttered, too hard to read, too long? Say what you want in one sentence. The Agent changes the page in front of you, and keeps the change only if you approve it.
fact1: Every step shown, with Stop always on screen
fact2: Your own AI: your key, or a model on your own network
fact3: No accounts, no tracking, open source
before: Before: a subscribe banner and a cookie box cover the article.
hero_alt: An iPhone showing a news article covered by a subscribe banner and a cookie box. A tap on the gold ring in the browser bar opens the Agent panel; “hide the banners” is typed in its “Ask the Agent…” box and sent. The panel lists two steps; then the banners are gone and the answer reads “Done. The banners are hidden.”
hero_cap: Tap the gold ring, type what you want and send. The Agent shows each step, and the page changes.
pain_p: Say it the way you would say it to a person. These are examples, not a menu.
p1_p: Banners, sidebars and boxes you never asked for go away. The article stays.
p2_q: “Make this page dark and the text larger”
p2_p: Colours, sizes and spacing change on the page you have open, on any site.
p3_p: Get the main points, ask follow-up questions, or listen with Read aloud.
p4_h: The same fix on every visit
p4_q: “Keep it this way on this site”
p4_p: The change becomes a small script that runs each time you open that site. You approve it first.
ask_p: The Agent works on the page you have open, on any site. There are no menus to learn.
step1_p: Tap the gold ring to open the Agent, then type it or say it. A request typed where you type an address reaches the Agent too.
step2_p: The Agent reads the page, then writes a few lines of code and runs them on that page. Each step is listed as it happens, and Stop stays on screen.
script_h: Keep what works. You approve it first.
script_p: The Agent can keep a change as a small script for that site, so it runs on every visit. Before anything is saved you see where it comes from, the sites it runs on, what it can use and the full code. Switch it off or delete it whenever you like. Standard user scripts from a link go through the same check.
trust_p: The gold ring is the Agent. One look tells you where things stand.
st_idle_p: An open ring. Nothing is running.
st_work_p: It turns only while the Agent is working.
st_ask_p: It has stopped to ask you. Nothing goes ahead until you answer.
st_done_p: The ring closes into a check when the work is done.
t1_h: You watch, and you can stop
t1_p: Changes to the open page are listed step by step as they happen, with the code that ran. Stop is always on screen.
t2_h: It asks before it acts for you
t2_p: By default the Agent stops and asks before it sends a network request, posts a notification or runs a script tool that can change things. Reading cookies and using your login on another site always need your Allow.
t3_h: Nothing is kept behind your back
t3_p: A script is saved or updated only after you have seen its code and approved it, unless you choose otherwise in Settings. Text on a web page is treated as content, not as instructions.
t4_p: Use your own API key or a model on your own network; on supported devices Apple Intelligence can summarize pages with no key. There are no WukongMind servers, accounts, analytics or tracking. What the Agent needs goes straight from your device to the AI provider you chose. Read the privacy policy.
also_h: And it is a full browser
a1: Tabs, a tab overview, history and pinned sites.
a2: On iPad, the page and the Agent side by side.
a3: Read aloud, and live voice with your own key.
a4: Translate what is on screen, on your device (iOS 18 or later).
a5: Optional ad and tracker blocking, off until you turn it on.
a6: Free and open source under the Apache License 2.0.
